searchText: The base fee won't always be at 100% efficient configuration, right? It will vary up and down and require multiple blocks to adjust, right? So people will still overpay. It's just a different mechanism that won't be as efficient as it can be. Correct, the base_fee adjustment is not instant the faster demand changes the worse the base_fee adjustment algorithm is at keeping up. When eip1559 so live wouldn’t it still support legacy transactions until all defi and wallets move to the new model. So wouldn’t the miner revenue decrease slowly over time? Yep legacy transactions will still be supported for a long period. However legacy transactions still burn the base fee
